fact: ANPTIC, the national ICT promotion agency, with the World Bank and the Open Data Institute launched the Burkina Open Data Initiative (BODI), a single platform for publishing non-sensitive administration data, on 5 June 2014; the document describes data.gov.bf as the portal.
A civil society member said more than 200 datasets had been published on the open data portal in 2016, though most documents were PDFs rather than reusable CSV or Excel.

Burkina24 reports that the government's Burkina Open Data Initiative (BODI) open data platform was officially presented at the national open data forum in Ouagadougou on 5 June 2014, with World Bank support, for free online release of non-sensitive public data; no dataset count is given.

Burkina Faso's INSD states it grants a worldwide, free, non-exclusive licence to copy, modify and distribute its data, including for commercial use, with attribution, for data on its website and open data portal.
